strings.en: Already saved. It's on Home.
strings.description: Toast after tapping Finish on a live recording when the server had already saved that conversation on its own. 'Home' is the app's conversation list tab.

strings.en: Omi hasn't received this audio yet. It will be processed when it arrives.
strings.description: Toast after tapping Finish when the page showed words but the server has none of the audio yet (a wearable device's audio is still on its way). The recording carries on.

strings.en: Couldn't reach Omi to finish this conversation. Nothing is lost.
strings.description: Error toast after tapping Finish on a live recording when the request got no answer (offline, timeout, server error). Shown with a Try Again button; the transcript stays on screen.

strings.en: Couldn't finish this conversation. Nothing is lost.
strings.description: Error toast after tapping Finish on a live recording when something in the app failed. Shown with a Try Again button; the transcript stays on screen.

strings.en: Omi can't use the microphone. Allow it in Settings to record.
strings.description: Error toast when the user taps the record button but the microphone permission is blocked. Shown with an Open Settings button.

strings.en: Couldn't start recording.
strings.description: Error toast when the phone recording failed to start for an unknown reason. Shown with a Try Again button.

strings.en: Couldn't check your plan. Your purchases are safe.
strings.description: Error toast after Restore Purchases when the app could not reach the server to read the plan. Shown with a Try Again button. Must never imply the user is on the free plan.

strings.en: Couldn't check for firmware updates.
strings.description: Error state on the device firmware page when the update check got no answer (offline, server error). Shown with a Try Again button, instead of 'up to date'.

strings.en: This conversation is still shared. Anyone with the link can view it.
strings.description: Error toast after sharing a conversation failed or was dismissed and the app could not make it private again. Shown with a Make Private button.

strings.en: Couldn't save your goal.
strings.description: Error toast when creating, editing, or moving the progress of a goal failed. Shown with a Try Again button; the goal editor stays open.

strings.en: Couldn't delete the goal. It's back in your list.
strings.description: Error toast when deleting a goal failed on the server and the goal returned to the list. Shown with a Try Again button.

strings.en: Couldn't load your goals.
strings.description: Error state on the Goals page when goals could not be loaded and none are stored on the phone. Shown with a Try Again button.

strings.en: That recording has ended. It's on Home.
strings.description: Toast when a notification or card links to a live recording that has already ended. 'Home' is the conversation list tab.

strings.en: This memory is no longer available.
strings.description: Toast when a link points to a memory that was deleted or is not on this phone.

strings.en: This task is no longer available.
strings.description: Toast when a link points to a task that was deleted or could not be read.

strings.en: Couldn't open this conversation.
strings.description: Error toast when a cited or linked conversation could not be opened (deleted, locked, or offline). Shown with a Try Again button.

strings.en: Couldn't refresh. Showing what's on this phone.
strings.description: Error toast after pull-to-refresh on the conversation list failed; the rows already shown stay. Shown with a Try Again button.

strings.en: Connect your device to use Offline Sync.
strings.description: Toast when the user taps Offline Sync while their wearable device is disconnected.

strings.en: You'll be signed out, and this phone's Omi settings will be reset.
strings.description: Confirmation dialog message before 'Use a Different Account' during onboarding signs the user out and clears local settings.

strings.en: Setup finished, but your glasses weren't found. Make sure they're on and nearby.
strings.description: Error toast when Ray-Ban Meta glasses setup completed but a rescan did not find the glasses. Shown with a Try Again button.

strings.en: Couldn't load more tasks.
strings.description: Notice at the end of the task list when loading the next page failed. Shown with a Try Again button.

strings.en: Couldn't move the task. It's back where it was.
strings.description: Error toast when dragging a task to another section failed to save. Shown with a Try Again button.

strings.en: {count, plural, =1{Deleted. 1 locked task was kept.} other{Deleted. {count} locked tasks were kept.}}
strings.description: Toast after clearing a section of tasks when some tasks are locked (on a paid plan feature) and were intentionally kept. {count} is the number of locked tasks kept.

strings.en: Couldn't save that change.
strings.description: Error toast when a settings change failed to save and was put back. Shown with a Try Again button.

strings.en: Couldn't load your notification settings.
strings.description: Error state on the notification settings page when the settings could not be read from the server. Shown with a Try Again button.

strings.en: Wait for Omi to finish answering.
strings.description: Toast when the user tries to clear the chat or switch chat persona while Omi is still answering.

strings.en: Voice note too short. Hold to record.
strings.description: Toast when a chat voice note was shorter than half a second and was not sent.

strings.en: Add a name, description, image, category and capability to submit.
strings.description: Hint under the disabled Submit App button explaining what the form still needs.

strings.en: Setup isn't finished yet. Finish it in your browser, then tap Try Again.
strings.description: Notice on an app's page when waiting for the user to complete the app's setup in the browser timed out.

strings.en: Nothing to Keep
strings.description: Title on the processing page when the server discarded the finished recording (too short or no speech). Title Case.

strings.en: Finish the capability and pricing details above to submit.
strings.description: Small hint under a disabled Submit button on the create-app form, shown when the name, description, image, category and capability are filled in but a capability-specific field (a prompt, a trigger, notification scopes) or the paid plan details are still missing.
